ruleDefinitions.name: Automated Collection Command PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.doc.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.docx.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.xls.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.xlsx.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.ppt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.pptx.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.rtf.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.pdf.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.txt.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ChildItem.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Recurse\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Include\\ .*")))
